card.name: Spaces and linking words in diarrhea/infection text
card.fires_on: Spaces after dose frequency before a duration, and odd spots such as the x in moxifloxacin, in text about diarrhea and infection. Also linking words in hygiene and waterborne-illness text.

modes.label: Space before duration
modes.description: A blank space between a dosing interval and the number of days of treatment for infectious diarrhea.
modes.example: 500 mg every 12 hours<< >>5 to 7 days Typhoid

modes.label: Inside moxifloxacin
modes.description: The x within the antibiotic name moxifloxacin or toxigenic in diarrhea-related text.
modes.example: Avoid fluoroquinolones, including mo<<x>>ifloxacin hydrochloride, in

modes.label: Hygiene and illness phrasing
modes.description: A small linking word in public-health text about avoiding germs or foodborne illness.
modes.example: importance<< of>> avoiding drinking water from unprotected water sources.

card.writes: It pushes toward wash-related words such as washed and washing, as in hand-washing advice.
card.plain: It fires in diarrhea and infection text, where the next idea may be washing hands or hygiene.
